title: AI Engineering
promptHint: Structure your task and generate a prompt ready to copy.
local: Content is prepared in your browser without a model connection. Nothing is sent automatically; copy your work before leaving.
replace: Loading a template replaces the current inputs. Continue?
empty: Enter a task objective to create a prompt.
reviewRole: You review code for correctness and maintainability.
reviewTask: Review the changes below for reproducible issues and suggest fixes.
reviewContext: Paste the code changes, runtime environment and expected behavior here.
reviewConstraints: Separate confirmed issues from hypotheses. Do not invent test results. List any missing information.
reviewFormat: List priority, location, trigger, impact and fix for each issue. Finish with verification steps.
requirementsRole: You translate business requirements into testable engineering tasks.
requirementsTask: Break down the requirements below into user flows and implementation tasks.
requirementsContext: Enter target users, scenarios, existing capabilities and raw requirements here.
requirementsConstraints: Identify assumptions and open questions. Reuse existing capabilities. Give each task verifiable completion criteria.
requirementsFormat: Provide scope, user flows, tasks, edge cases and acceptance criteria.
writingRole: You are a careful technical editor.
writingTask: Turn the material below into clear operating instructions.
writingContext: Enter the audience, prerequisites and verified procedures here.
writingConstraints: Use supplied facts only. Mark unknowns for confirmation and preserve important limitations.
writingFormat: Provide purpose, prerequisites, numbered steps, expected results and troubleshooting.
costHint: Enter token usage and provider rates to estimate repeated request costs.
costNotice: Rates are entered by you; examples are not model prices. Use one currency and prices per million tokens. Cache, reasoning charges, tool fees, taxes and volume discounts are excluded.
invalid: Enter finite non-negative values. Token counts and request counts must be integers, with at least one request.
formula: Total = (input tokens × input rate + output tokens × output rate) ÷ 1,000,000 × requests. Currency selection changes the unit only, not the exchange rate.
workflowHint: Break an AI project into checkable steps from requirements to validation.
session: Checks track progress on this page only. They do not run tasks or call a model and are cleared on refresh.
assistant1: Define the audience, questions to answer and unsupported scope.
assistant2: Prepare role, context, output format and three representative inputs.
assistant3: Decide how to ask for missing information rather than invent answers.
assistant4: Test normal, ambiguous and out-of-scope questions; record before-and-after results.
rag1: Identify allowed documents with sources, versions and update dates.
rag2: Prepare questions and reference answers, including questions absent from the documents.
rag3: Check that retrieved passages contain the answer and retain traceable references.
rag4: Check retrieval relevance and answer accuracy separately; rerun examples after document updates.
automation1: Define each tool’s inputs, outputs, permissions and action scope.
automation2: Separate reading, preparation and execution; define confirmation points for important actions.
automation3: Plan timeout handling, retries and duplicate execution handling.
automation4: Rehearse success and failure flows on test data and retain auditable execution records.
evaluation1: Fix a test set and reference criteria covering common tasks and edge cases.
evaluation2: Record prompt version, model configuration, inputs and actual outputs.
evaluation3: Evaluate correctness, completeness, latency and cost separately, not just one good answer.
evaluation4: Compare the same examples before and after changes; retain failures as regression cases.
